author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: PHP2Shell attacks have surged into the millions, but no successful exploitation is confirmed. Patch it immediately. On October 21, PHP released emergency patches for two critical vulnerabilities tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS score of 9.2), affecting every PHP version that handles web requests. title: PHP2Shell: Millions of Attacks, No Confirmed Successful Exploits Yet
